card.name: Thresholds before blood count values
card.fires_on: The word "to" after "greater than or equal", or the gap right after "at least", just before a platelet or neutrophil count number. Also the "/d" in g/dL for hemoglobin.

modes.label: Count threshold wording
modes.description: Linking word or gap before a numeric platelet or ANC cutoff in dose-modification rules.
modes.example: ANC less than 500/mm 3 and platelets greater than or equal<< to>> 50,000/mm

modes.label: At least before count
modes.description: The position right after "at least" or "level" before a platelet count number.
modes.example: Platelet count should be at least<< >>100 x 10

modes.label: Hemoglobin units
modes.description: The middle of g/dL in a hemoglobin value.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward blood-related words such as blood, transfusion and hematologic terms.
card.plain: It fires where a blood count limit, like platelets of at least some number, is about to be given.
